title: Wait, Octopuses Have Three Hearts?

scenes.narration: Three. And one of them stops beating every time it swims.
scenes.speaker: B

scenes.narration: It's why they'd rather crawl. Swimming wears them out.
scenes.speaker: B

scenes.narration: Okay, but why is their blood blue?
scenes.image_prompt: cinematic underwater photo: blue ocean water
scenes.speaker: A

scenes.narration: Copper. Their blood carries oxygen with copper instead of iron.
scenes.speaker: B

scenes.narration: Pretty much. Follow for more ocean weirdness.

description: Three hearts, blue blood and arms that can taste. The octopus might be the strangest animal on Earth. Which fact surprised you most?
